bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
db=deploy-postgres-1
docker inspect "$db" --format '{{.State.Running}}' | grep -x true >/dev/null || exit 70
docker exec "$db" psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -A -F '|' -c "SELECT feature,enabled,length(source_commit)=40 AS source_bound,length(trim(ci_evidence))>0 AS ci_bound,length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0 AS runtime_bound,length(trim(telegram_e2e_evidence))>0 AS telegram_bound FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature IN ('room','announcement') ORDER BY feature" || exit 71
docker exec "$db" psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -A -F '|' -c "SELECT state,count(*) FROM room_source_events GROUP BY state ORDER BY state" || exit 72
docker exec "$db" psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -A -F '|' -c "SELECT state,count(*) FROM room_status_message_edits GROUP BY state ORDER BY state" || exit 73
docker exec "$db" psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -A -F '|' -c "SELECT status,count(*) FROM room_posts GROUP BY status ORDER BY status" || exit 74
echo ROOM_PUBLIC_SYNC_GATE_READONLY_PASS
